opening.argument: The walkthrough presents joining a OneCoin business as a sequence of actionable steps, beginning with entry through a sponsor’s link: “when you go to a link of your sponsor what invited you to this business.” It then provides operational registration guidance, including account setup—“and so the first name is your login”—and explains how to proceed with payment or defer it: “you need to choose payment if you are not sure you can do by clicking choose payment or they want to make a payment later.” Alongside the account interface’s emphasis on direct sponsorship and bonus progression, this encourages participation in a recruitment-linked token business and selecting a paid package, rather than warning about or investigating the offer.
